verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents automated workflows, and its AI Editor can create and modify ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, review or approval of changes, or rollback for those automations. Versioning automations is a fair question for a compliance automation platform, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
